metadata.description: Which state income tax thresholds rise with inflation each year by law, tax year 2026
metadata.primary_source: Tax Foundation - State Individual Income Tax Rates and Brackets, 2026 (footnotes on indexing)
metadata.notes: brackets: bracket thresholds (null for a flat tax, which has none). deduction: the standard_deduction amount in tax_brackets_2026.json (a personal exemption or the federal deduction in some states). Thresholds that are not indexed lose value in today's dollars (see app/engine/inflation.py). Checked against state sources where the table disagreed; each state's source is listed.

AL.note: No indexing; brackets and $3,000/$8,500 SD (AGI phase-down) fixed by statute.

AR.note: Brackets indexed (TF fn j); SD indexed with 3% annual cap ($2,410 in 2025 to $2,470 in 2026).

AZ.note: Flat 2.5%; SD equals the federal amount (TF fn u).

CA.note: Brackets and SD indexed (TF fn j, n); $1M mental health surtax threshold not indexed (fn nn).

CO.note: Flat 4.4%; starts from federal taxable income, so federal SD applies (TF fn o).

CT.note: No indexing; $15,000/$24,000 personal exemption fixed and phases out with AGI.

DC.note: Brackets not indexed. 2026-2029 DC sets its own SD = 2025 amounts ($15,000/$30,000) with annual COLA (FY2027 budget act); federal SD from 2030.

DE.note: No indexing; brackets and $3,250/$6,500 SD fixed.

GA.note: Flat rate; $12,000/$24,000 SD fixed by statute, not indexed.

HI.note: No indexing; Act 46 (2024) raises brackets and SD in scheduled legislated steps, not by inflation. TF shows SD $4,400/$8,800 for 2026.

IA.note: Flat 3.8%; starts from federal taxable income, so federal SD applies (TF fn o).

ID.note: Flat 5.3%; federal SD (TF fn o, u). Idaho's 0% band (~$4,811/$9,622) is indexed (fn j) but the model has no band.

IL.note: Model SD is 0 (no SD). Unmodeled personal exemption IS indexed ($2,850 in 2025, $2,925 in 2026; TF fn d).

IN.note: Model SD is 0 (no SD). Unmodeled $1,000 exemption is fixed, not indexed.

KS.note: K.S.A. 79-32,119 fixes SD at $3,605/$8,240 for 2024+ with no COLA; brackets not indexed.

KY.note: Flat 3.5%; SD indexed by statute ($3,270 in 2025, $3,360 in 2026; TF fn d).

LA.note: Flat 3%; SD $12,500 indexed annually from 2026 ($12,875; TF fn d).

MA.note: Modeled 4% surtax threshold indexed (MGL c.62 s.4); $4,400/$8,800 personal exemption is at its statutory cap, no COLA.

MD.note: Brackets not indexed. 2025 BRFA set flat SD $3,350/$6,700 indexed to COLA after 2025. Model's $2,700/$5,450 is the old formula max.

ME.note: Brackets indexed (TF fn bb); SD tied to federal SD (fn u; fn vv says pre-OBBBA conformity, still indexed).

MI.note: Model SD is 0 (no SD). Unmodeled personal exemption IS indexed ($5,800 in 2025, $5,900 in 2026; TF fn d).

MN.note: Brackets and Minnesota's own SD indexed (TF fn bb, d).

MO.note: Brackets indexed (TF fn bb); SD equals federal SD (fn u).

MS.note: No indexing; $10,000 exempt band, $2,300/$4,600 SD and exemptions fixed. Rate is 4.0% for 2026 (model has 4.4%).

MT.note: Brackets indexed (TF fn bb); starts from federal taxable income, so federal SD applies (fn o, u).

NC.note: Flat 3.99%; $12,750/$25,500 SD fixed by statute, not indexed.

ND.note: Brackets (incl. 0% band) indexed (TF fn j); federal SD applies (fn o, u).

NE.note: Brackets and SD indexed (TF fn bb, d); SD $8,850/$17,700 for 2026.

NJ.note: No indexing; $1,000/$2,000 exemptions and brackets fixed.

NM.note: Brackets (2024 HB 252) not indexed; uses federal SD (TF fn o, u).

NY.note: No indexing; $8,000/$16,050 SD and brackets fixed by statute.

OH.note: R.C. 5747.02(A)(5) indexes brackets, but HB 96 suspended indexing of brackets and exemptions for 2025-2026. Model SD is 0.

OK.note: No indexing; TF states HB 2764 brackets (3 brackets from 2026) not indexed; $6,350/$12,700 SD fixed.

OR.note: Brackets indexed except top $125k/$250k threshold (TF fn bb, nn); SD indexed ($2,910/$5,820 in 2026; fn d).

PA.note: Flat 3.07%; no SD or personal exemption.

RI.note: Brackets and SD indexed (TF fn bb, d); SD $11,200/$22,400 for 2026.

SC.note: Brackets indexed (TF fn bb); federal SD via federal taxable income (fn o, u; fn vv pre-OBBBA conformity, still indexed).

UT.note: Flat 4.5%; credit is 6% of the federal SD (moves with federal) and its phaseout threshold is indexed (TF fn d, gg).

VA.note: No indexing; SD changed only by legislation ($8,750/$17,500 for 2026 per TF).

VT.note: Brackets and SD/exemption indexed (TF fn j, n).

WI.note: Brackets and sliding-scale SD indexed (TF fn bb, d); SD $13,960/$25,840 for 2026.

WV.note: No indexing; model SD 0, $2,000/$4,000 exemption fixed.
